requirements.text: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. This position is not eligible for sponsorship
•Hands-on experience administering enterprise AI platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or comparable), including API management, access controls, and environment configuration
•Familiarity with LLM application infrastructure, including prompt pipelines, Model Context Protocol (MCP), vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns, and embedding workflows
•Experience monitoring distributed systems or SaaS platforms, including alerting setup, log review, and diagnosing performance or availability issues
•Working knowledge of information security principles as applied to SaaS and API-based systems - access controls, credential management, data handling, and audit logging
•Strong documentation habits, including runbooks, SOPs, architecture notes, and internal guides
•Experience working with Databricks or a comparable data/ML platform
•Familiarity with usage and cost monitoring for cloud or API-based services
•Experience contributing to cross-functional teams alongside product, engineering, and operations stakeholders
•Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues and program staff
